title: Browser Autonomy Benchmark Suite
description: Live set is Rollercoaster and Fireworks with the frozen A/B/C prompt ladder. Ant Colony is suspended in .archives with its prompts and published takes preserved. Additional v2.0.0 benches are shelved locally.

A.name: Raw
A.purpose: Minimum task statement. Measures natural interpretation, unsolicited judgment, and how well the model presents the idea without extra direction.

B.name: Autonomous
B.purpose: A plus exactly 20 words granting explicit authority over unspecified design, pacing, composition, and implementation decisions.

C.name: Showcase
C.purpose: B plus exactly 20 words requesting stronger presentation quality without prescribing concrete features or interaction patterns.

promptLadder.construction: B = A + autonomousSuffix; C = B + showcaseSuffix.
promptLadder.autonomousSuffix: Make design, pacing, composition, and implementation decisions yourself wherever details are unspecified, turning the idea into a coherent finished experience.
promptLadder.showcaseSuffix: Push toward presentation-ready quality with stronger art direction, motion, depth, transitions, atmosphere, and meaningful detail while preserving clarity and coherence.

benchmarks.title: Rollercoaster

prompts.A: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js.
prompts.B: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js. Make design, pacing, composition, and implementation decisions yourself wherever details are unspecified, turning the idea into a coherent finished experience.
prompts.C: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js. Make design, pacing, composition, and implementation decisions yourself wherever details are unspecified, turning the idea into a coherent finished experience. Push toward presentation-ready quality with stronger art direction, motion, depth, transitions, atmosphere, and meaningful detail while preserving clarity and coherence.

benchmarks.notes: Do not add hidden implementation requirements beyond the prompt. Evaluate what the model chooses to contribute.
